messages:
harper: FYI noticed repeated tail latency and short GPU stalls in us-west1 tied to NVMe write bursts from a few tenants on fractional slices. Seems like KV flush + outbound egress combined with IO pressure on the node. Anyone seen this pattern before? :thinking:

noah: can you paste the prom query and an example tenant id?

harper: sure. sample tenant: tenant-crest. query: 
```
sum(rate(kv_out_bytes{region=\"us-west1\"}[1m])) by (tenant)
node_nvme_write_latency_seconds_p95
```

diego: infra-bot shows correlated alerts: us-west1_nvme_write_surge and slice_gpu_stall in same time window. infra-bot:alert_id=usw-nv-092

infra-bot: Alert usw-nvme_write_surge started at 2025-01-14T03:22:11Z severity=warning

yun: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) soft egress carveout (limit outbound bytes per-slice) 2) NVMe IO pacing for noisy pods 3) warm-standby rehome for affected neighbors 4) fallback to same-region hosted for sustained overload. Prefer pacing over eviction to avoid cache thrash.

noah: agree on pacing. We can attach eBPF IO shaper + NIC shaping instead of heavy tc. Prototype eBPF config: 
```
program: io_egress_pacer v0.1
flags: nvme_write_cap_mb=30, net_rate_mbps=80, burst_sec=20, fallback=hosted-us-west1
metrics: tenant_paced_count, rerouted_tokens_est
```

harper: detection heuristic to avoid noise: require nvme_write_p95 > threshold AND kv_out_rate > X AND gpu_runqueue_p95 > Y for 90s. Example: 
```
WHEN nvme_write_latency_p95 > 0.5s AND kv_out_bytes_rate > 120MB/2m AND gpu_runqueue_p95 > 0.3s FOR 90s
```

diego: ops playbook draft: 
- enable pacing canary on 3% of fractional slices in us-west1 for 24h
- mark tenant owner on first pace event and auto-create ticket if >3 events/hour
- emit metrics: tenant_paced_count, slice_paced_seconds, rerouted_tokens_est
- revert pacing for slice if false positive within 10m

yun: add billing tag billing:egress_mitigation=true when reroute occurs so Finance can see token movement. Also prefer same-az hosted variant to minimize egress fees.

noah: implementation owners: Diego wires the playbook and alerts, Yun pushes eBPF shim to staging, Harper will produce 1h sample telemetry for canary. infra-bot schedule?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: io_egress_pacer v0.1 scheduled to staging at 4309940000 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

diego: final ask: add metric slice_nvme_pressure_seconds so we can correlate pacing with NVMe recovery. Optimize wants 48h of metrics before wider rollout.

harper: will add the samples and the cost sketch: tenant-crest ~1.1M bytes/10m -> ~42k tokens -> ~$0.11 if rerouted; but preventing 30-60s neighbor stall likely saves several dollars in GPU-minutes. :thumbsup:
